description: Source code for the main frontend of a Tic Tac Toe game built with Flutter. It defines the app widget, game screen, state management, UI components for game grid, status, indicators, and actions.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget setting up the MaterialApp with theme and the home screen.

classes.name: TicTacToeScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the main game screen with grid, status, and controls.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that runs the TicTacToeApp.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state to initial values.

methods.name: handleTap
methods.description: Handles user tapping a cell, updates game state, and determines game result.

methods.name: _computeWinner
methods.description: Checks the game board for a winner or draw.

methods.name: _statusText
methods.description: Generates status message based on game state.
